items.title: Chinese national arrested at airport after alleged $20,000 bribe
items.description: A Chinese national has been extradited to Queensland over an alleged attempt to bribe a public official with a bag of tea containing $20,000 in cash.

items.title: Breaking: Seven new suspected H5 bird flu cases detected in SA
items.description: Federal Agriculture Minister Julie Collins says urgent testing is being conducted by the CSIRO.

items.title: Quick hits: Wiggles star's daughter shines, netball 'cleaner' goes viral
items.description: Two Aussie besties share a podium, and a very famous face wiggles his way into the stands. Here are the quick hits from day three of the Commonwealth Games.

items.title: Deputy premier tells Allan he will run for Victorian Labor leadership
items.description: A delegation of Labor ministers and MPs has met with Jacinta Allan to urge her to step down, but the Victorian premier has vowed to fight any leadership challenge.

items.title: Live: Taylor hoses down Liberal senator's suggestion of coalition with One Nation
items.description: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor rejects a Liberal senator's suggestions of a Liberal-One Nation coalition after the next election. Follow live.

items.title: Live: ASX jumps, oil slumps after US and Iran pause missile attacks
items.description: The ASX has opened 1 per cent higher as global oil prices slump on easing tensions in the Middle East. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Husband mourns 'unfair' crash that killed wife as DV offender fled
items.description: A man says it is "unfair" his wife and the mother of their two young boys has died following a head-on car crash with a man police say had been driving erratically after stabbing his partner.

items.title: The test coming to all mobile devices and what to know before it lands
items.description: Australia is about to get its first taste of a new nationwide emergency warning system, where millions of devices across the country are expected to sound off simultaneously later today.

items.title: He earned $400k a year, but Luke Bateman couldn't afford groceries
items.description: Luke Bateman was 19 and living out his NRL dream when he went to a casino for the first time. It kickstarted a gambling addiction, and he retired from sport $250,000 in debt.

items.title: We had the origin of more than 200 tomato products tested. The results were shocking
items.description: One of Australia's biggest tomato brands and two major supermarkets are selling products that exclusive forensic testing shows have misleading labelling.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
